info.title: HomeRadar Mallorca API
info.description: Headless API that watches low-competition property sources in Mallorca, records every listing change and tells its owner what they can afford. Conventions: kebab-case paths, camelCase JSON, ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, money as {amount, currency}, cursor pagination and RFC 9457 problem details for every error.

get.summary: List listings with simple query-string filters.
get.description:
Quick listing lookup driven by query-string parameters. It is a thin front for `searchListings` with the most common filters
(municipality, price range, source, "new within N hours") and the same cursor envelope. Use `searchListings` for geographic,
history-based or multi-value filters.

Results default to `Active` and `Relisted` listings, newest first (`firstSeenAt`). `daysOnMarket` counts from the publication
date when the source publishes one (Solvia, Aliseda, Inmovilla) and from the first time HomeRadar saw the listing otherwise.

`affordableFor` (financing profile id) and `budget` (EUR) apply the affordability filter described in `searchListings`.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

post.description:
Full-text-free structured search over every listing HomeRadar has ingested. All filters are optional and combine with AND.

**Geography.** `municipalities` compares case-insensitively with the municipality published by the source. `polygonWkt` is a
WKT polygon in WGS84 (`POLYGON((lon lat, …))`) evaluated with PostGIS. `radius` is a circle in metres around a point, evaluated
on an EPSG:25831 projection so distances are metric. Listings without coordinates never match geographic filters.

**History.** `daysOnMarket`, `priceDropsMin`, `cumulativeDropPercentMin` and `newWithinHours` come from the append-only change
log, not from the source: a drop is only counted once HomeRadar has seen both prices.

**Possession.** Bank-owned stock often carries `NoPossession` (occupied, moratorium) or `RentedUntil`; `excludePossession`
removes those. `Unknown` means the source gave no signal.

**Pagination.** Keyset cursors: pass back `nextCursor` unchanged with the same filters and sort. Changing the filters or sort
with an old cursor returns a 400. Sorts: `FirstSeenDesc` (default), `PriceAsc`, `PriceDesc`, `PricePerM2`, `PriceDropDesc`.
Listings without a price sort last for price-based sorts.

**Affordability.** `affordability.financingProfileId` keeps listings whose price is at most the profile's maximum affordable
price for the listing's island (value limits differ per island) and kind (resale pays ITP; new build pays VAT + AJD). The
maximum is the same one `calculateMaximumAffordablePrice` returns: highest price with verdict `Affordable` (or `Borderline`
with `minimumVerdict`), taxes and closing costs included, with the profile's loan-to-value or an eligible ICO/IBAVI guarantee
when `includeGuarantees` is true. `affordability.budget` keeps listings whose price + taxes + closing costs fit in the budget,
taxed at standard rates unless a profile is also given. Listings without a price never pass. Renovation is not included until
the rule-based estimator of phase 3. Unknown municipalities are treated as Mallorca, like in the analysis.

get.summary: Get a listing with its photos, features and sibling listings.
get.description:
Returns the current state of one listing: summary fields, description, normalised features, photos with their perceptual hash
(once computed) and the cadastral reference when the source publishes it. `features` holds source-specific facts under stable
keys (`elevator`, `terrace`, `parking`, `pool`, `yearBuilt`, `energyRating`, `previousPrice`, `discountPercent`, `badges`,
`condition`, `postalCode`, `address`, `reference`, `campaign`, `specialSituation`, `cadastralParcel`…). `enrichments` holds facts
derived by the rules engine, each labelled with its origin.

`siblingListings` lists other listings of the same physical home once cross-source deduplication (phase 4) has matched them.

Lists every stored financing profile. Profiles are seeded from `config/seed/financing-profiles*.yaml` at worker start-up and can

post.description:
Creates a financing profile. `key` must be unique. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe: the same key with the
same body replays the original response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different body is rejected with 409.

Money is accepted as `{amount, currency}` with `currency` fixed to `EUR`. The response carries a weak `ETag` to use in later
`PUT` calls.

get.summary: Analyse whether a listing is affordable with a financing profile.
get.description:
Answers "can I buy this one, and what would it really cost?" for one listing and one financing profile (the default profile
when `financingProfileId` is omitted). Deterministic, rule-based and reproducible.

**What goes into the total cost.** Price + taxes + notary + land registry + gestoria + appraisal (only with a mortgage, the
only mortgage cost left to the borrower by Ley 5/2019) + mortgage opening fee (if the profile has one) + guarantee fee (IBAVI
charges 0.5 % of the guaranteed amount). Renovation is added from phase 3; until then a warning reminds it is missing.

**Taxes.** Resale pays transfer tax (ITP) on the higher of price and cadastral reference value; new homes pay VAT (10 %, 4 %
for protected special regime) and stamp duty (AJD). The engine reads the tax rule sets valid on the calculation date for the
state (`ES`) and the Balearic Islands (`ES-IB`) — none of the figures live in code. For every tax it starts from the standard
rule (or a mandatory override such as AJD 2 % from 1 M EUR), evaluates every reduced rate and bonus against the buyer data,
and applies the cheapest option whose requirements are **all met**. Requirements that cannot be checked with the profile
(IRPF base, gross income, net worth…) make a relief `Unknown`: it is not applied, and `potentialSaving` tells how much less
would be paid if they were met. Reduced rates in the Balearic Islands cover the first 270,151.20 EUR and need the value to be
within the island limit (331,859.70 EUR in Mallorca since 2026-06-14); the excess pays 8 % ITP or 1.5 % AJD.

**Loan and payments.** Loan = price × loan-to-value (appraisal assumed equal to price). Monthly payment with the French formula
`L·i / (1 − (1 + i)^−n)`, `i` = annual rate / 12. Variable loans pay the initial rate for `fixedMonths` (12 by default when an
initial rate is given) and then Euríbor + spread; mixed loans pay the fixed rate for `fixedMonths`. Both are computed under
every Euríbor scenario of the business configuration (base, +1, +2 points).

**Verdict.** `Affordable` when savings cover deposit, taxes and costs, and (highest base payment + existing debts) / net
income is within the profile's limit, also under the stress scenario. `Borderline` for small gaps: shortfall up to the
configured tolerance (5,000 EUR), debt-to-income up to 3 points over the limit, the stress scenario over the limit, or a loan
ending after age 75. `NotAffordable` for anything larger. Each reason carries its amount or ratio.

**Guarantees and aid.** Every aid programme valid on the date is evaluated (ICO and IBAVI guarantees, the Govern's 10,000 EUR
grant). When a guarantee raises the loan-to-value, `withGuarantee` repeats the analysis with it (ICO and IBAVI are never
combined). Grants are paid after the purchase and are budget-limited, so they never count as cash on signing day.

**Maximum price.** `maximumPrice` is the highest price, to the cent, whose verdict stays `Affordable`; `bindingConstraints`
are the reasons that appear one cent above it.

**Reproducibility.** The analysis is stored with its inputs (listing content hash, profile version, business configuration
and tax rule set ids, date). The same inputs return the stored analysis (`reused: true`); any change creates a new one.

post.summary: Simulate a purchase without a listing.
post.description:
Runs the same analysis as `getListingAnalysis` on a purchase described in the request, without a listing: price, resale or new
build, municipality (it decides the island value limit), optional cadastral reference value and renovation budget. Financing
comes from `financing` (inline assumptions), else from `financingProfileId`, else from the default profile.

Use it to play with margins: "if I buy at X and renovate for Y, what does it cost and can I still afford it?", or to see how
a different Euríbor (`euriborPercent`) changes the payments of a variable or mixed mortgage. Renovation adds the contingency
percentage of the business configuration (10 % by default). `on` evaluates the rules, island limits and aid valid on another
date. Nothing is stored.

post.summary: Highest price a financing profile can pay.
post.description:
Inverse calculation: the highest price the profile can pay with verdict `Affordable` (or `Borderline` with `minimumVerdict`),
taxes and closing costs included, for a resale or new-build home in a municipality, optionally keeping a renovation budget on
top.

Every constraint grows with the price — cash needed (deposit, taxes, fees), debt-to-income — and taxes only jump upwards (for
example when the value crosses the island limit and the reduced rate is lost), so the set of affordable prices is an interval.
The engine finds its upper end by doubling from 50,000 EUR and then bisecting to the cent; the price returned is affordable
and one cent more is not. `bindingConstraints` tells what limits it (usually the savings shortfall or the debt-to-income).

With `includeGuarantees`, each candidate price is evaluated with the best ICO or IBAVI guarantee the buyer qualifies for at
that price (IBAVI requires a price up to 382,744.84 EUR). `atMaximum` holds the full analysis at the maximum price.

get.summary: Business configuration valid on a date.
get.description:
Business assumptions that are not law and therefore are not tax rules: the Euríbor 12M reference and the scenarios used for
variable and mixed mortgages, the stress scenario of the verdict, the Borderline tolerances, the usual maximum age at loan
maturity, the renovation contingency and the market estimates of gestoria and appraisal.

They come from `config/seed/business-config.yaml`, loaded into the database as immutable versions keyed by validity date and
revision. Returns the version valid on `on` (today by default): the latest `validFrom` on or before that date, highest
revision. Every stored analysis records which version it used.

example.source: Euríbor October 2026 (Banco de España press note 2026-11-03); thresholds and estimates from docs/fiscalidad-baleares.md §3.3 and §5

get.description:

so analyses computed with an older revision can still be explained.

get.summary: Tax rule sets applied on a date.
get.description:
Audit view of the tax rules the engine applies: the effective tax rule set of every level of `jurisdiction` (default: the
business configuration's jurisdiction, `ES-IB`, which also returns `ES`) on date `on` (today by default).

Each set contains the island value limits (`subdivisions`), the rate, scale and bonus rules with their eligibility conditions
and legal source (`rules`), the notary and land registry tariffs (`fees`) and the aid programmes (`aidPrograms`). Rules marked
`verified: false` are interpretations pending an official criterion and surface as warnings in analyses. Sets are seeded from
`config/seed/tax-rules/*.yaml`, validated on load (a set with errors is rejected and logged) and never edited in place.

financingProfileId.description: Financing profile whose maximum affordable price is applied.

oneOf.description: Total budget: price + taxes + closing costs must fit in it.

includeGuarantees.description: Count an eligible ICO or IBAVI guarantee when it raises the loan-to-value.

AffordabilityFilterDto.description: Affordability filter. With a profile, a listing passes when its price is at most the profile's maximum affordable price for its island and kind (resale or new build); with a budget, when price + taxes + closing costs fit in it; with both, both limits apply.

borderlineCashShortfallMax.description: Largest savings shortfall in EUR still considered Borderline.

borderlineDebtToIncomeTolerance.description: Debt-to-income points above the profile limit still considered Borderline (fraction).

maxAgeAtLoanMaturity.description: Usual maximum age at the end of the loan.

renovationContingencyPercent.description: Contingency added to renovation budgets, in %.

maxLoanToValue.description: For guarantees: loan-to-value it allows for this buyer.

oneOf.description: For grants: amount paid after the purchase (never counted as cash on signing).

budgetLimited.description: True when the programme can run out of budget.

verified.description: False when some figure is pending official confirmation.

businessConfigVersionId.description: Business configuration version id (Euríbor, thresholds, closing-cost estimates).

businessConfigValidFrom.description: Date from which that business configuration applies.

taxRuleSets.description: Tax rule sets applied, from the state to the most specific jurisdiction.

on.description: Calculation date: rules, island limits and aid programmes are those valid on this day.

AnalysisConfigurationDto.description: Configuration versions an analysis was computed with; together with the stored inputs they make it reproducible.

revision.description: Revision within the same validity date; a higher revision replaces a lower one.

loadedAt.description: When the version was loaded from the seed files (UTC).

defaultJurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction whose tax rules apply, e.g. ES-IB.

rateScenarios.description: Scenarios used for variable and mixed loans: Euríbor reference plus a delta in percentage points.

stressScenario.description: Scenario used as stress test for the verdict.

closingCosts.description: Market estimates of closing costs without an official tariff.

BusinessConfigDto.description: Version of the business assumptions that are not law: Euríbor reference, stress scenarios, verdict thresholds and closing-cost estimates.

age.description: Age in years (18–99) of the oldest buyer: age limits of reliefs and aid are checked against it.

residentInBalearics.description: Currently resident in the Balearic Islands.

yearsResidentInBalearics.description: Years of residence in the Balearic Islands.

taxableIncomeBase.description: IRPF taxable base in EUR, needed for the 100 % ITP bonus (limit 52,800 € individual).

netWorth.description: Net worth in EUR, needed for the ICO guarantee (≤ 150,000 €).

ownsOtherHome.description: Owns (≥ 50 %) another home now. When omitted, a first-home buyer is assumed to own none.

yearsResidentInSpain.description: Years of legal residence in Spain (ICO requires 2).

jointTaxReturn.description: Files a joint IRPF return (limit 84,480 € instead of 52,800 € for the 100 % bonus).

grossAnnualIncome.description: Gross annual income of the household in EUR, needed for the ICO and IBAVI guarantees and the 10,000 € grant.

hasDependentChildren.description: Has dependent children (ICO guarantee without age limit).

disabilityMinimumForRelatives.description: Applies the IRPF disability minimum for ascendants or descendants (2 % ITP).

BuyerProfileDto.description: Personal circumstances that decide which tax reductions and aids apply.

gestoriaEur.description: Gestoria for the purchase deed, EUR.

appraisalEur.description: Official appraisal paid by the borrower, EUR.

category.description: Notary, LandRegistry, Gestoria, Appraisal, MortgageOpeningFee, GuaranteeFee, Renovation or RenovationContingency.

estimated.description: True for market estimates rather than official tariffs.

sourceUrl.description: Source of the tariff or estimate.

base.description: Analysis with the profile's own loan-to-value.

oneOf.description: Same purchase financed with the best guarantee programme the buyer qualifies for (ICO or IBAVI), when it raises the loan-to-value; otherwise null.

aid.description: Eligibility for every aid programme valid on the calculation date.

oneOf.description: Highest price that keeps the verdict Affordable with the profile's loan-to-value, all other assumptions equal.

FinancialAnalysisDto.description: Complete financial analysis of a purchase.

savings.description: Savings available for deposit and costs.

netMonthlyIncome.description: Net monthly income of all borrowers.

FinancingAssumptionsDto.description: Financing assumptions given inline instead of a stored profile.

revision.description: Revision applied from seed files; API updates do not change it.

savings.description: Savings available for deposit and costs.

netMonthlyIncome.description: Net monthly income of all borrowers.

isDefault.description: Use this profile when none is specified.

IntRangeDto.description: Integer range filter with inclusive bounds.

analysisId.description: Analysis id; the same inputs return the same stored analysis.

calculatedAt.description: When the analysis was first computed (UTC).

reused.description: True when an identical earlier analysis (same listing content, profile version and configuration) was returned.
